mapper.sql: id, task_id, attempt_no, base_ref, status, exit_code, token_input, token_cached_input, token_output, branch_name, executor, agent_name, device_id, lease_expires_at, last_heartbeat_at, last_event_at, summary, raw_result, schema_valid, changed_files, started_at, finished_at, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.task_id, r.attempt_no, r.base_ref, r.status, r.exit_code, r.token_input, r.token_cached_input, r.token_output, r.branch_name, r.executor, r.agent_name, r.device_id, r.lease_expires_at, r.last_heartbeat_at, r.last_event_at, r.summary, r.raw_result, r.schema_valid, r.changed_files, r.started_at, r.finished_at, r.created_at FROM task_run r JOIN task t ON t.id = r.task_id JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND ( p.owner_id = #{ownerId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_member pm WHERE pm.project_id = p.id AND pm.user_id = #{ownerId} ) ) AND t.deleted = 0
SELECT FROM task_run WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY attempt_no DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM task_run WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY attempt_no
SELECT FROM task_run WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND executor = #{executor} ORDER BY task_id, attempt_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task_run (task_id, attempt_no, base_ref, status, exit_code, token_input, token_cached_input, token_output, branch_name, executor, agent_name, lease_expires_at, device_id, last_heartbeat_at, last_event_at, summary, raw_result, schema_valid, changed_files, started_at, finished_at, created_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{attemptNo}, #{baseRef}, #{status}, #{exitCode}, #{tokenInput}, #{tokenCachedInput}, #{tokenOutput}, #{branchName}, #{executor}, #{agentName}, #{leaseExpiresAt}, #{deviceId}, #{lastHeartbeatAt}, #{lastEventAt}, #{summary}, #{rawResult}, #{schemaValid}, CAST(#{changedFiles} AS JSON), #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE task_run SET status = #{status}, exit_code = #{exitCode}, token_input = #{tokenInput}, token_cached_input = #{tokenCachedInput}, token_output = #{tokenOutput}, summary = #{summary}, raw_result = #{rawResult}, schema_valid = #{schemaValid}, changed_files = CAST(#{changedFiles} AS JSON), lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, last_heartbeat_at = #{lastHeartbeatAt}, last_event_at = #{lastEventAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM task_run WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND executor = #{executor} AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY lease_expires_at
SELECT FROM task_run WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND executor = #{executor} AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY lease_expires_at
SELECT FROM task_run WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY id
